OYO STATE (PSI 7.0): Oyo State Government Completes LAUTECH Faculty Building in Iseyin
ADAMAWA (PSI 9.4): Approved over ₦46bn in contracts including ₦14.76bn Mubi-Gella road to Cameroon, 300 75-hp tractors, NPK fertilizers, Innoson buses, and tertiary student hostels.
ENUGU (PSI 9.1): Commissioned multi-billion-naira Anchorage Pharmaceutical plant in Enugu, establishing state commercial supply deals for 260 primary healthcare centres.
EDO (PSI 8.8): Partnered with NDPHC for 450MW power distribution under Electricity Act, flagged off Student Biometrics, and demolished properties used by organ harvesters.
BAYELSA (PSI 8.7): Declared South-South Governors' firm rejection of merging Coastal Highway with East-West Road, insisting both distinct transport projects proceed independently.
KATSINA (PSI 8.6): Flagged off FarmerMoni enumeration for ₦300k smallholder loans with NSIPA, commissioned 4 schools in Muduru, and sponsored fees for 100 students.
LAGOS (PSI 8.5): Commenced 4-day SESP validation workshop with UNICEF/NIEPA, received SON MANCAP Award for consumer protection, and launched fire training for 450 personnel.
ONDO (PSI 8.2): Inaugurated secondary school students as Tuberculosis Ambassadors in Akure to drive peer education and combat the state's 16.1% TB prevalence.
NIGER (PSI 8.1): Received News Engineering and Mahashakti delegation in Abuja proposing technical execution for the IDB-funded 100MW solar energy project.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.0): Inducted 632 newly recruited nurses and midwives across public hospitals, and partnered with UNICEF on Kits That Fit cholera assessment in Gusau.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 7.8): Local Government Auditor General pledged open-door policy and swift grievance resolution during courtesy visit by Association of Local Government Pensioners.
TARABA (PSI 7.6): Information Commissioner represented Governor Kefas at Media Trust AI newsroom launch in Abuja to study digital integrated newsroom models for state media.
PLATEAU (PSI 7.5): Received 40 Starlink internet kits with 13-month subscriptions from Both Ends Believing to digitize Children First Software across 34 child care homes.
GOMBE (PSI 7.4): Assured Tangale community delegation of Billiri General Hospital rehabilitation plans, while urging media organizations to prioritize agricultural education.
OYO (PSI 7.0): Completed the construction of the College of Agriculture Faculty Building at the LAUTECH satellite campus in Iseyin to expand higher education access.
